disclosure: Retrospective case study written 2026-10-24 with the outcome known. Not predeclared before 2024. A hindsight exercise, not a prospective test and not evidence of predictive accuracy.
steps: Quarterly operating and investing flow = nine-month flow / 3, exact in cents.
Quarter change / 92 days = one constant daily change, exact in cents.
Nowcast at the cutoff = origin balance + 41 days of the daily change. Same in baseline and response.
Target = nowcast + 51 days of the daily change.
Cash outside restricted cash = combined cash minus restricted cash held flat (AS-RESTRICTED). Modeled estimate, never observed.

observation.note: Revealed only after the cutoff. Observed cash outside restricted cash (H01) is reported, so it can score the modeled estimate.

response.unmodeledNote: UNMODELED. A1-DOWNSIDE (0 to USD 13.75M a year, timing unknown, feasibility unknown) is not a run input and is not netted into any figure. The response shows cost only, with no benefit claim. The downside is a visible limitation, not a zero.
response.postHocReason: Chosen in a retrospective with the outcome known, though no number was tuned from the outcome. Hypothetical, feasibility unknown.
response.pointNote: The response point is the midpoint of the cost range, not an estimate.

riskRulesNote: No evidenced threshold, so no rule is scored.
excluded: all debt, loan and lender facts
all narrative, outlook and management statements
non-cash metrics (revenue, net loss, adjusted EBITDA)
unverified filing text; the earlier research files stay as an audit archive, not runtime input
